title: Law School ROI by Career Track
description: 10-year NPV comparison of four JD career tracks: BigLaw, In-House/Mid-Market, Government, and Public Interest. Models PSLF loan forgiveness, IDR vs. standard repayment, break-even year, and opportunity cost. Extends AL-39 (MD-only) to cover JD economics.
data_vintage: NALP 2024 · DOJ GS scale 2025 · IBR/SAVE 2024 · Federal poverty guidelines 2025
regulatory_citations: NALP 2024 associate salary survey (BigLaw Cravath scale $225K)
